newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's foreign reserves at all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's foreign reserves at all-time high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves reached an all-time high of $10.115 billion as of May 9, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
It said net reserves grew 2.2 percent, or $219.3 million, between Dec 30 and the week ending May 9.
The central bank sees net reserves, which have increased by 27.6 percent since May 10 of last year, growing by a total of $750 million in 1997.
